title: Review V2 detailed design and development plan
goal: Independently review TASK-027 for implementability, V2 scenario fidelity, migration and compatibility safety, and executable work-package boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Review checks the complete detailed design and actual TASK-027 change set against all accepted overall-design requirements
Review validates exact DDL/API/DOM/state/migration/test contracts and rejects ambiguity that would make implementation roles guess
Release evidence records an exact change manifest, content fingerprint, findings, and two consecutive full passes on unchanged content

release_controls.target_environment: local dev branch detailed-design review workspace
release_controls.execution_window: current V2 detailed-design independent review session
release_controls.rollback_plan: remove unrecorded review evidence and return TASK-027 for correction
release_controls.observation_metrics: structured findings, exact change manifest, content fingerprint, implementation-readiness checklist, and Release governance results
release_controls.stop_conditions: missing contract, design drift, destructive migration ambiguity, V1 compatibility gap, or incomplete evidence
